method.era_normalization: rates z-scored within each season's 400+ PA population; the prospect's translated line is z-scored against the latest season
method.outcome: PA/yr and PA-weighted era-relative OPS over the 5 seasons after the match season; cohort counts only matches with a complete follow-up window, deduped by player
method.pool: MLB hitting seasons 2000-2025, PA>=400, age<=26, pitchers excluded
